content_sections.heading: Chamarajanagar District Court Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026 includes vacancies for Peon, Stenographer Grade-III, Stenographer and Typist posts.

content_sections.heading: Chamarajanagar District Court Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the educational qualification and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the respective post notification. Stenographer: Educational Requirement: Applicants must have passed the Second PUC (Pre-University Course) or a equivalent three-year diploma. Technical Requirement: Candidates must have passed the Senior Grade exam in Kannada and English shorthand and typing, conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board. Alternative Qualification: Those holding a Diploma in Commercial Practice/Secretarial Practice can apply if they have passed the Senior Grade typing/shorthand exams in both Kannada and English. Typist: Must have passed Second PUC or any equivalent three-year Diploma Course or equivalent examination And Must have passed Senior Grade Kannada and English typewriting subjects conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board. OR Must have passed Diploma in Commercial Practice / Secretarial Practice and if they have passed typewriting in any one of the Kannada / English languages, such candidates [must pass] typewriting in the remaining Kannada / English language. Typist & Copyist: Candidates must have passed 2nd PUC, a 3-year Diploma, or an equivalent qualification. Proficiency in both Kannada and English typing is required, specifically by passing the Junior Grade examinations conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board. Alternatively, candidates with a Diploma in Commercial Practice or Secretarial Practice must pass the Junior Grade typing exam for the remaining language if they have already passed it in one of the languages. Peon: Passing the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board or equivalent qualification. Must know how to read and write Kannada (a test will be conducted on reading and writing Kannada and general knowledge)

faq.question: Q1. What is Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by the District & Sessions Court, Chamarajanagar for Peon, Stenographer Grade-III, Stenographer and Typist posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 25 vacancies are available under Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in Chamarajanagar District Court Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Peon, Stenographer Grade-III, Stenographer and Typist.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification varies according to the post. For Peon posts, candidates must have passed 10th standard. Stenographer and Typist posts require the qualifications and typing skills mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years. The maximum age limit is 35 years for General category, 38 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B candidates, and 40 years for SC/ST and Category-I candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Chamarajanagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates have to pay ₹200, while SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted from the application fee.
